record_scope_reconstruction: Owner-present personal SUVs travelling from Saudi Arabia to Yemen through Al-Wadiah; commercial vehicle classes remain separate.

source_checks.finding: March report describes Saudi Sharurah-port denial of personal SUVs and the related Yemeni Al-Wadiah controls.
Official port director reports owner SUVs permitted from Saudi Arabia to Yemen on April 25; more than 100 vehicles had crossed that morning.
